name: Eliel
overview: Eliel is a male figure identified in Scripture as the Mahavite, a designation that distinguishes him within the biblical record. His tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not specified in the text. The reference to Eliel occurs in 1 Chronicles 11:46.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliel means 'G-d is my G-d,' reflecting a personal acknowledgment of God's sovereignty. This proper name, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 11:46, does not appear to have been given directly by God but carries a meaningful theophoric element common in Hebrew names.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Eliel beyond what is indicated by his unique attribute as the Mahavite. There are no additional relational details provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Eliel's mention as the Mahavite in 1 Chronicles 11:46 places him among the notable warriors or leaders associated with King David's reign. Though the text provides limited information, his inclusion signifies a recognized role within the historical and spiritual heritage of Israel. This brief but specific identification highlights his part in the collective narrative of God's people during a formative period.
